Overview & Purpose

This standard operating procedure (SOP) defines deployment best practices for machine learning models used in the Energy Optimization Platform. It aims to minimize risk, maintain service stability, and ensure measurable improvements through controlled rollout strategies such as blue/green and canary deployments.

Applies To

  • ML models optimizing HVAC, battery storage, or DER dispatch in commercial sites.
  • Services in the EcoSync Energy Optimization Platform (production and staging).
  • MLOps teams, ML engineers, data scientists, and SREs.

Prerequisites

  • Model readiness: Passed evaluation and validation gates (ref: KB0018620, KB0018654).
  • Versioning: Model artifact tagged (e.g., energy-optimizer:1.12.0) and registered with metadata (features, training data time range, schema).
  • Observability: Metrics and logs wired: latency, error rate, drift, business KPIs (kWh saved, cost delta).
  • Rollback plan: Preconfirmed last-known-good (LKG) version and automated revert procedure.
  • Change ticket: Change record approved with risk assessment and deployment window.

Deployment Patterns

Blue/Green

Provision a parallel green environment. Route a small percentage of traffic to green, then switch all traffic after verification.

Canary

Gradually increase traffic to the new model across cohorts (5% → 25% → 50% → 100%), pausing or rolling back if thresholds are violated.

Shadow

Run the new model in parallel, capturing predictions but not impacting user outcomes; compare KPIs before promotion.

StrategyRiskSpeedUse Case
Blue/GreenLowModerateInfrastructure changes; clear cutover.
CanaryLow–ModerateFast–GradualModel-only updates; strong monitoring.
ShadowVery LowSlowExploratory models; KPI comparison.

Procedure

  1. Package & register: Build container image; push to registry; create release notes.
  2. Config & feature parity: Validate feature store schemas and transformations against LKG.
  3. Staging verification: Deploy to staging; run end-to-end tests and backtest against a recent week.
  4. Choose rollout strategy: Select blue/green or canary based on change type and risk.
  5. Initial rollout: Start at 5% traffic (canary) or green environment with limited routing; monitor closely.
  6. Automated gates: Enforce thresholds for latency, error rate, prediction drift, and business KPIs.
    • Latency p95 < 300 ms
    • Error rate < 0.5%
    • Drift score < 0.1 (population stability index)
    • KPI improvement ≥ 2% compared to LKG
  7. Increment & observe: Increase traffic to 25% → 50% → 100% if gates pass.
  8. Cutover: Switch all traffic to the new model (blue/green) and decommission green after stability period.
  9. Post-deploy review: Document outcomes, lessons learned, and update model registry notes.

Verification

Validate service health, correctness, and business impact before full cutover.

# Health Check (example)\nGET /healthz\n200 OK\n\n# KPI Snapshot\nkwh_saved_delta: +2.7%\ncost_savings_delta: +1.9%\nerror_rate: 0.3%\nlatency_p95: 240ms\n

Rollback

  1. Trigger automated rollback to LKG via pipeline job (rollback-to:lkg).
  2. Restore routing to blue environment (or reduce canary to 0%).
  3. Invalidate caches if feature changes were involved.
  4. Open incident if thresholds were exceeded; attach logs and metrics.

Troubleshooting

Symptoms

  • Spike in error rate or latency.
  • Business KPIs degrade beyond tolerance.
  • Prediction drift detected against reference distribution.

Cause

  • Feature schema mismatch or transformation bug.
  • Data pipeline lag or partial outages.
  • Model overfitting to recent training window.

Resolution

  • Revalidate feature schemas; run contract tests.
  • Resync data pipelines; backfill missing partitions.
  • Retrain with broader timeframe; add regularization; retune thresholds.

Additional Information

  • See attached ML_Deployment_Pipeline_Overview.png for reference architecture.
  • Change management: link the deployment to a CAB-approved ticket and record the window.
  • Security: ensure container images are scanned and signed; rotate credentials after cutover.

Related Articles

  • KB0018620 — Evaluation best practices for energy optimization ML models.
  • KB0018654 — Validation workflows and gates for energy optimization ML models.
